response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009;

assumptions.assumption: The count includes every fee record above the fee-rate threshold; AVG ignores records with a missing rebate rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only fee records that contribute a nonmissing ratio to the average.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_ratio, COUNT(rebrate) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009;
